niche.diet: Chemosynthetic (radiolytic H2, serpentinised CH4, Fe(III)/sulfate redox)

body: Flattened, segmented, with a mineralized dorsal plate and hydrostatic suckers

links: Converts mechanical strain to electrochemical signals
Maps fracture geometry and distant seismic swarms

skill.effect: The creature strikes the ground, drawing nearby allies to its side and soothing aggressive fracture-dwellers into a calm state.

chains.weakness: Deaf to high-frequency gas bubbles, so venting CO2 startles them
observe: Dorsal plate glints faintly under mantle heat
Body trembles in time with distant quakes

journal.en: They don't see the dark; they listen to the rock breathe.
